reviews.title: Great CPU fan!
reviews.comment: Great, high powered fan! Just watch out for case edge clearance. It didn't quite fit into my SFF build (shiny snake L300 + Minisforum BD8950i SE).
reviews.author: tl

reviews.title: Love my quieter fans
reviews.comment:
It is awesome!!  Replaced lian li 140mm and it is much quieter and has helped drop CPU temps (also replaced the other 9 lian li 120 with noctua 120mm) but 10-15 degrees Celsius at idle...
Figure noise dropped by around 50%-60%.  They are worth the money
reviews.author: Arthur Ahrens
